deleteAccount.warningIntro:
Uninstalling the app or deleting your Juple account does not cancel Google Play or Apple App Store subscriptions. Cancel in the purchasing store subscription settings first.

All of the following will be permanently deleted:
deleteAccount.dataPhotos: Uploaded photos (link photos, collection photos and your profile photo)
deleteAccount.dataCollections: Your collections and their public links
deleteAccount.dataSharing: Shared collections you joined, the links you added to them, and invitations you sent or received
deleteAccount.dataFriends: Friends, friend requests and friend notes

pasteShare.title: Paste or share a link
pasteShare.body:
Paste a URL into the field at the top of Home and tap the button on the right. You can also paste text that contains a link; the first link in it is used.

You can also send a link from a browser or another app: open its share menu and choose Juple. This works on Android and on iPhone and iPad.

quickSave.title: Quick Save
quickSave.body:
Turn on Quick Save in My Page and links you share from other apps are saved right away, without the review screen.

When it's off, Juple shows you the link first. Edit the title, add a memo and choose collections, then save.

review.title: Before you save
review.body:
When the link's public page can be read, Juple fills in the title and preview image for you. Information that can't be confirmed is never guessed, so type the title yourself.

Add a memo and pick one or more collections, or create one on the spot. For a collection that needs approval, the link goes to the owner as an approval request.

androidShortcuts.title: Shortcuts and Direct Share
androidShortcuts.body:
Long-press a collection to select it, then tap Shortcut in the bar at the bottom to put a shortcut to that collection on your Home screen. See 'Home screen shortcut' under Organizing with collections.

You can also send a link straight to a collection from your phone's share menu. Locked collections, collections with a password and collections you can't add links to don't appear as share targets.

When a collection appears as a share target, its menu has 'Remove from share targets'. This only removes it from the share menu. The collection, its links and any Home screen shortcut you made stay as they are.

home.title: Home
home.body:
Home shows the links you saved today, newest first. The field at the top stays in place while you scroll, so you can save a link at any time.

Tap a link to open its details. Use the buttons next to Recent to switch between list, grid and image views. Tap the bell on Home to open notifications.

archive.title: Archive
archive.body: Archive keeps every link you've ever saved, grouped by date, newest first. Type at least two characters in the search field to find older links.

linkDetails.title: Link details and editing
linkDetails.body:
Tap a link to open its details. You can edit the title and memo, change the collections it's in and change the cover photo, then save. Use the open-link button to open the original page.

You can't edit a link someone else added to a shared collection. Long-press it to select it, then use More > Save link to save it as your own link.

swipe.title: Swipe for quick actions
swipe.body: In the list and grid views of Home and Archive, swipe a link sideways to reveal quick actions such as share and delete. The actions depend on the link. For example, links in a locked collection can't be shared from here.

searchSort.title: Search and order
searchSort.body:
Archive, the Collections tab and each collection have a search field. A link search starts once you type at least two characters. Home has no search.

Links are always shown newest first; there is no separate sort button.

viewModes.title: List, grid and image views
viewModes.body:
Use the view buttons to see links as a list, a grid or images. Image view shows pictures in 3 columns. On the Collections tab you can see collections as a list or a grid. Each screen remembers its own view.

When you switch views, the list starts again from the top.

selectLinks.title: Selecting several links
selectLinks.body:
Long-press a link to start selecting; an action bar appears at the bottom. Tap other links to add them, and use Select all or the close button at the top to change or end the selection.

Home and Archive: Change collection sets the collections for all selected links at once, and Delete moves them to Recently Deleted. More has copy link and share, and with a single link also open link and edit.

Inside a collection: Delete (removes from this collection), Move and Copy. In a shared collection you can move only links you added, and you can report other people's links. If only some succeed, the ones that failed stay selected.

selectCollections.title: Selecting several collections
selectCollections.body:
Long-press a collection on the Collections tab to start selecting. The bar at the bottom offers lock and delete or leave. With a single collection, More offers notifications on or off, Share and Edit. The buttons you see depend on the collection and your role.

Your own collections are deleted; collections someone else shared with you are left. If you select both kinds, one confirmation shows the counts and 'Delete and leave' does both. Collections that fail stay selected.

When several are selected, locked collections are skipped. To delete a locked collection, select it on its own and enter its password. Deleting a collection doesn't delete the links that were in it.

createCollection.title: Creating and editing collections
createCollection.body:
Tap the + button on the Collections tab. Choose a name, icon and color, or use your own photo. One link can be in several collections.

To change the name or look, select the collection and use More > Edit, or the menu on the collection's screen. Only the collection's owner can edit it.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.body:
Tap a collection's star to add it to Favorites, and tap it again to remove it. Favorites apply only to you.

Use the Favorites, All, My collections and Shared buttons at the top of the Collections tab to choose which collections are shown.

homeShortcut.title: Home screen shortcut (1×1)
homeShortcut.body:
Long-press a collection, keep only that one selected and tap Shortcut in the bar at the bottom to make a 1×1 icon for it on your phone's Home screen. Tapping the icon opens that collection in Juple.

This appears only when your launcher supports Home screen shortcuts. A locked collection still asks for its password when opened from the icon. To remove the icon, delete it from your Home screen yourself.

manageLinks.title: Copying and moving links
manageLinks.body:
Open a collection, long-press links to select them, and use the bar at the bottom to move or copy them to another collection. Delete only takes them out of this collection; your links themselves stay.

On Home or Archive, Change collection changes the collections of several links at once.

Right after moving or deleting, you can undo it from the message that appears.

publicLink.title: Share a Collection by link
publicLink.body:
Open a Collection and tap Share. Under Public collection settings, turn it ON so anyone with the link can view it, in the app or on a web page. Choose what visitors may do: read only, add after approval, or add links directly.

Turn it OFF to keep the Collection private: people with the link see only its name and can ask to join. You can stop sharing at any time.

invite.title: Invite friends or people by ID
invite.body: In Share, pick friends or enter someone's Juple ID, choose what they can do, and send the invitation. They join once they accept. You can add friends in My Page > Friends.

roles.title: What each permission allows
roles.body:
Read-only: can view the Collection. Needs approval: can suggest links, and the owner approves them. Can add links: can add links directly. The owner manages the Collection, its sharing and everyone's permission.

A public link's setting is the lowest level anyone can have. You can give invited people a higher one.

joinRequests.title: Join requests and waiting for approval
joinRequests.body:
When Public collection settings is OFF, people who open the link can ask to join. The owner sees the requests on the collection's share screen and approves or declines them. An approved person joins as a read-only participant. Someone who was declined can ask again later.

When you ask to join, the collection shows as 'Waiting for approval' on your Collections tab until the owner answers. Long-press it to cancel your request.

approvals.title: Link approval requests
approvals.body:
These are different from join requests. They are links that someone with "Needs approval" permission suggests for a Collection. The owner finds them under Received approval requests and approves or declines each one.

If you suggested a link, find it under Sent approval requests, where you can cancel it.

comments.title: Comments and reactions
comments.body: Open a link in a shared collection to leave comments and replies, like comments and react with emoji together with other participants. You can edit or delete your own comments.

collectionLock.title: Locking a collection
collectionLock.body:
First set a lock password in My Page > Collection lock. Then long-press a collection on the Collections tab to select it and tap Lock collection in the bar at the bottom.

A locked collection can't be opened until you enter the password, and its links are hidden on Home and in Archive too. To unlock, select just that collection and enter the password.

You can also lock a collection someone else shared with you so that only you see it locked. This lock applies only to you and doesn't affect the owner or other participants.

accessPassword.title: Access password for sharing
accessPassword.body: When you share a Collection you can also set an access password. People opening the shared Collection must enter it. It is separate from your own lock, and you can see, change or remove it in Share.

friends.title: Adding and managing friends
friends.body:
My Page > Friends has the Friends, Received, Sent and Blocked users tabs. The Received and Sent tabs show how many requests are waiting.

Tap the + button and enter the other person's Juple ID to send a friend request. Once they accept, you're friends. Accept or decline received requests, and cancel sent ones.

You can search your friend list. Tap a friend to see the collections you share, and long-press or swipe a friend to remove them.

blockReport.title: Blocking and reporting
blockReport.body:
You can block people you don't want to interact with. Once blocked, you can't exchange friend requests, invitations or join requests, and in shared collections you don't see the links each other added. Comments and reactions of a person you blocked are hidden from you as well. Saved data isn't deleted, and you can unblock at any time from the Blocked users tab.

If you block the owner of a collection you've joined, you leave that collection.

You can report users, collections, links and comments that are a problem. Juple staff review reports, and the reporter's information is never shown to the other person.

notificationCenter.title: Notifications
notificationCenter.body:
Tap the bell on Home to open notifications; the number of unread notifications is shown on it. On the web, open Notifications from the menu. Tap a notification to go to the related screen. You can mark all as read or delete them one by one.

You're notified about things like friend requests and answers, collection invitations, join requests and their results, links added to shared collections, approval requests, and comments, replies and reactions.

You can turn notifications on or off for each shared collection. When they're off, notifications still appear in the list, but no push notification is sent.

notices.title: Notices
notices.body: Important announcements, such as service changes or updates to the terms, are in My Page > Notices.

deleteRestore.title: Deleting and restoring
deleteRestore.body:
Delete a link by swiping it, by long-pressing to select it, or from its details. Deleted links move to Recently Deleted in My Page, where they are kept for up to 30 days, up to 100 links. From there you can restore them, delete them permanently or empty the list. Permanently deleted links can't be brought back.

Removing a link from a collection isn't deleting it. Right after deleting a collection, you can undo it from the message that appears.

trialPeriod.title: Free trial
trialPeriod.body:
The free trial is once per person and lasts exactly 720 hours (30 days). Existing members who signed up before 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026 can use it until 10:00:07 a.m. on December 27, 2026 (Korea Standard Time); members who signed up after that can use it for 720 hours from the moment they signed up.

The free trial starts without a payment method and, when it ends, you're never charged and it never turns into a paid subscription by itself. Deleting your account and signing up again doesn't start a new trial. Check the remaining time in My Page > Membership.

plansBilling.title: Monthly and yearly membership
plansBilling.body:
Membership is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. You pay through Google Play on Android and the App Store on iPhone and iPad; it isn't sold on the web. Prices and currencies differ by country and store; the amount shown on the membership screen and the store's payment screen before you buy is what applies.

If you subscribe during the free trial, you're charged that same day, and the remaining free time isn't added to the subscription.

Membership belongs to your Juple account, so you can use it with the same account on Android, iPhone and iPad, and the web. Subscribing in both stores at the same time charges you twice, so cancel one of them.

restorePurchases.title: Restoring purchases
restorePurchases.body:
If you reinstalled the app or moved to a new device and your subscription isn't showing, tap Restore purchases on the membership screen. It checks the subscription bought with this device's store account again and applies it to your Juple account.

A subscription already linked to another Juple account isn't moved.

cancelSubscription.title: Cancelling a subscription
cancelSubscription.body:
Cancel in the store you paid through. On Android, go to Google Play > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions; on iPhone and iPad, go to Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions, choose Juple and cancel. The membership screen can also take you to the store's page.

After cancelling, you can keep using the membership until the end of the period you already paid for. Refunds follow the store's policy.

Cancelling a subscription and deleting your account are separate. Deleting the app or your account doesn't cancel the subscription, so cancel it in the store first.

afterTrial.title: After the trial ends
afterTrial.body:
When the free trial has ended and you have no valid subscription, Juple becomes read-only. Your saved links and collections aren't deleted, and you can keep viewing them.

Still available: viewing links and collections, opening original links, exporting and deleting your data, leaving collections, settings, buying and restoring a subscription, the Customer Center, reporting and blocking, and deleting your account.

Restricted: saving new links, creating and editing links and collections, adding, moving and copying links to collections, sharing settings and invitations, writing comments and reactions, friend requests and similar actions. To write to a shared collection, both you and its owner need access. Subscribe again and everything works as before right away.

profilePhoto.title: Editing your profile
profilePhoto.body:
Tap the edit button on the profile card in My Page to change your nickname and profile photo. After choosing a photo, move and zoom it with your fingers to fit the circle, then save.

Your nickname and profile photo are shown in collections you share with friends. Your Juple ID can't be changed.

settings.title: Language and display
settings.body:
In My Page > Language, choose one of 17 languages or Use system setting. The app switches to that language right away.

Use the Dark mode switch in My Page to turn the dark screen on or off. On the web, change it under Appearance in settings.

Send inquiries from My Page > Customer Center and read the replies there too.

legalDocs.title: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
legalDocs.body:
Open the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy from My Page > Customer Center or the membership screen. They open as web pages in the language you've set.

The Korean original is the legally binding text. Other languages are reference translations to help you understand it; if they differ, the Korean original prevails. A reference translation page links straight to the Korean original.

deleteAccount.title: Deleting your account
deleteAccount.body:
In My Page > Manage account > Delete account, check the data that will be deleted and tap Continue deleting account. Sign in again to confirm it's you, enter your Juple ID exactly as shown and tap Permanently delete account.

Deleting your account permanently deletes your links, collections, photos, friends, notifications and more, and can't be undone. Participants can no longer see the shared collections you created.

Deleting your account doesn't cancel a store subscription. Cancel it in Google Play or the App Store first.

useOnWeb.title: Using Juple on the web
useOnWeb.body:
Sign in at juple.co.kr in a computer or tablet browser with the same account to use your links and collections there.

On the web you can also save links and use Archive, collections, sharing, friends, notifications and settings. Saving from other apps' share menus, Home screen shortcuts and buying a membership work only in the mobile app. On the web you can check your membership status and go to the store's subscription management.

terms.serviceBody: Juple lets you save links, organize them into collections, and share and work together with other people.
terms.contentBody: The links, notes, photos, and collections you save are yours and are stored and shown only as needed to provide the service. You are responsible for the content you save and share.
terms.conductBody: Illegal content, infringing other people's rights, harassment, hate or threats, sexual exploitation or content inappropriate for minors, spam, fraud or impersonation, malicious links, unauthorized access, and automated bulk use are not allowed.
terms.reportBody: You can report users, collections, links, and comments in the app, and you can block other users. Reports are reviewed by people.
terms.restrictionBody: If the terms are violated, content may be restricted or removed, sharing stopped, some features limited, or the account restricted.
terms.subscriptionBody: Before the membership program begins, Juple is free to use without a payment method or subscription. The membership start date and revised terms effective date have not been set and will be announced before they apply. You will not be charged without your explicit purchase consent.

privacy.itemsBody:
• A sign-in identifier (issued by Microsoft Entra External ID; your email address and password are handled by Microsoft and are not stored on Juple's servers)
• Juple ID, nickname and profile photo (optional), language and time zone
• Links, notes, photos, collections, friends, invitations, comments, reactions, and support inquiries you enter
• Terms acceptance record, reports and blocks
• If you turn on push notifications: app installation ID and push token
• Service operation logs
• When using subscriptions: purchase tokens or signed transaction data (stored encrypted), product, status, start and expiry times
• Keyed hashes of sign-in identifiers and normalized sign-in email, and trial windows to prevent repeated trials (historical and official trials are separate)
privacy.purposeBody: To provide the service (saving, organizing, sharing, working together, notifications), verify accounts and keep them secure, handle reports and keep the service safe, answer inquiries, and keep the service stable. Also used for subscription verification, renewal and restoration, administrator-granted membership, and preventing repeated free trials after account deletion and re-registration.
privacy.retentionBody: Kept while you keep your account; deleting your account deletes your profile, links, collections, and more. Some records (operation logs up to 30 days, notification history 90 days, and so on) are kept only for the periods stated in the Privacy Policy and then deleted.
privacy.refusalBody: You may refuse. However, this item is required to provide the service, so you cannot use Juple without agreeing.

If you subscribe after the free period ends, your saved links and collections carry on just the same.

welcomeTrial.title: Welcome to Juple! 🎉
welcomeTrial.body:
Thank you for signing up.

Juple provides one free trial per user lasting exactly 30 days (720 hours). For existing members it starts when the membership program begins; for members joining afterward it starts at sign-up. It is not a store free trial and does not automatically become a paid subscription. Subscribing now charges you immediately, even if free time remains.

After the trial, you can still view existing links and collections, manage your account and subscription, restore purchases and delete your account. Without a valid paid subscription or administrator-granted membership, saving, creating, editing and other main write actions are restricted.

Manage membership in {{myPage}}.

welcomeTrial.existingMemberBody: Use Juple free for 30 days from the start of Juple membership!
welcomeTrial.plansAfterTrial: If you want to keep using Juple after the free trial, you can choose a monthly or yearly membership.

trialEnded.title: How was your month with Juple? 💜
trialEnded.body:
Thank you for using Juple over the past month!

Your free period has ended.

Everything you have saved is kept just as it is, and you can view it anytime.

To keep saving new links and managing your collections, please subscribe to a membership.
